# NCAAF Week 9 - Sat Oct 31

Edge factor ~0.58 applied.

## Pick
- **Arizona +3.5 at Texas Tech (-108), 0.5u (noon ET).** Covers AI projects TTU 28-26 (Arizona covers and gets the key number 3). Texas Tech is in QB trouble: Brendan Sorsby is gone, Will Hammond has 13 turnover-worthy passes vs 8 big-time throws, and backup Tommy Castellanos may play - fading the shaky-QB side is the Bengals template. TTU pass defense allows 266 yds/g. Six of nine CBS experts, Covers and Pickswise (high confidence) also on Arizona. Raw ~56% -> 53.5% vs 51.9% implied. Small: only one true model projection.

## Leans / passes
- Northwestern +3.5 at Oregon: SportsLine Oregon 30-21 (>60%) - against the dog; laying -3.5 is the hook through 3. Pass.
- Ohio State -6.5 at USC: true freshman Luke Fahey's first start (Sayin out). No model; pass.
- Minnesota +20.5 at Indiana: sharp move 22 -> 20.5 but 80% of tickets also on Minnesota; no model. Pass.
- Iowa -3.5 vs Wisconsin (Covers AI 20-14): hook through 3. Pass.
- Navy +30.5 (Covers AI ND by 30; sharps on ND). Pass.

## Update (10:15 AM) - second pick
- **Mississippi State +20.5 at Texas (-110), 0.5u (7:30 PM).** Two independent models now agree: SportsLine covers in >70% of sims and Covers AI projects Texas 34-20 (14-point margin). Kamario Taylor was hurt Sept 26, so MSU has played a month with the backup - the models' ratings already include it (unlike our losing fresh-backup spots). Big-spread model agreement is our best NCAAF template (Auburn +20.5, BYU +10.5, Cardinals +12.5). Raw ~62% -> 57% vs 52.4%. Small because of the QB and Texas's top-ranked defense.
- Syracuse +9.5 vs SMU: Covers AI SMU by 4, but numberFire 82.8% SMU (~12) and Kalshi 77% (~9.5). Split; pass.
- Other Covers AI single-model edges (Utah -6.5, Iowa State +9.5, Nevada +23.5, Auburn +13.5): no second model; pass.

sources.title: NBC: Kamario Taylor out for season

picks.summary: Covers AI TTU by 2 with +3.5 through the key number; Texas Tech QB turmoil; broad expert agreement.
SportsLine >70% and Covers AI (Texas by 14) agree the big spread is inflated; backup QB already a month in.
